title: Tax rule set
description: One tax rule set as stored in tax_ruleset. Not a topic: common sends the current sets inside compute.requested (`rulesets`) for tax kinds. Unsigned rule sets go out with estimate_only = true and are never used for filings (S-10). The seed files in examples/config.rulesets.*.json keep the envelope form.

rules.description: Rules-as-data per tax-engine.md (bands, rates, reliefs, thresholds).
